description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementReport class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin, responsible for preparing data and rendering a Vue.js component for leave entitlement reporting. It includes methods to initialize related services, assemble data for subunits, locations, and leave periods, and sets up the component accordingly.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementReport
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing data and rendering the leave entitlement report Vue.js component in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data for the Vue component, including subunits, locations, and leave periods, and sets the component for rendering.
